subject: physics
content: In an amplitude modulation, a modulating signal having amplitude of X Volt is superimposed with a carrier signal of amplitude Y Volt in first case. Then, in second case, the same modulating signal is superimposed with different carrier signal of amplitude 2Y Volt. The ratio of modulation index in the two cases respectively will be :
